items.speech: External power, if available: On.
Batteries one, two and essential: On.

notes: Workaround for a simulator bug where the wheel chocks may remain active internally.
items.speech: E F B panel state: Select on G P U. Workaround for a simulator bug where the wheel chocks may remain active internally.
A P U master switch: On.
A P U start switch: Press at least three seconds after the master switch is on.
items.condition: Minimum of 3 seconds after Master Switch On

items.speech: A P U bleed: On.
GADIRS: All on.
items.decision: GADIRS is spoken as a word, as in the cockpit.

items.speech: Navigation lights: On.
Emergency exit lights: Arm.
E F B flight details: Load from SimBrief.
E F B fuel and payload: Load from SimBrief and apply.

items.challenge: [INIT] FROM, TO, ALTN and CRZ FL
notes: INIT REQUEST loads them from SimBrief.
items.speech: Initialization page, departure airport, destination airport, alternate airport and cruise flight level: Set. The initialization request button loads them from SimBrief.
Wind page, company wind request: Execute.

notes: Open with DEPARTURE on the INIT page.
TMPY F-PLN inserts the selection and switches to the F-PLN page.
Delete discontinuities.
items.speech: Flight plan departure page, runway and Sid: Set and insert. Open the page with the departure button on the initialization page. The temporary flight plan button inserts the selection and switches to the flight plan page. Delete discontinuities.
items.decision: SID is spoken as the word Sid, as pilots say it.

items.speech: Fuel and load: Set zero fuel weight, zero fuel weight center of gravity, and block fuel. Use the E F B values.
notes: Use the EFB values.

items.speech: Takeoff performance: Compute and insert.
External power, if available: Off.
G P U: Remove, if connected. See Ground in the A four hundred M E F B.
notes: See Ground in the A400M EFB.

items.speech: A T C, A T I S: Get Q N H.
Altimeters one and two: Set Q N H from A T I S or M E T A R.
notes: Use ATIS or METAR
Check the departure runway and SID in the flight plan against the clearance.
items.speech: A T C clearance: Request I F R clearance. Check the departure runway and Sid in the flight plan against the clearance.

notes: Use the code from the IFR clearance.
items.speech: Transponder: Set the code from the I F R clearance.
Beacon light switches: Both and bright.
items.decision: The two BEACON switches are set together, so they share one item with both positions.

items.speech: A T C ground: Request pushback and engine start.
Pushback: Proceed.
Engine start mode: Ignition start.
Engine masters one to four: Feather, one at a time. Wait for the white half box to disappear.
notes: One at a time. Wait for the white half box to disappear.

items.speech: Parking brake: Set.
items.decision: Set after FEATHER and before RUN so the engines can be started during the optional pushback; it stays an action because the pushback needs a released brake.

items.speech: Engine masters one to four: Run.
Engine start mode: Normal.
A P U bleed: Off.
A P U master switch: Off.
Anti ice: As required.
Verify overhead panel: All lights out.
items.decision: Dark-cockpit check: no overhead switch annunciation such as ON or FAIL stays illuminated after engine start.

items.speech: Ground spoilers: Arm.
Flaps: Set to position one for takeoff.
Auto brakes: High, rejected takeoff.

notes: Button on the ECAM control panel below the displays.
items.speech: Takeoff configuration: Press the button on the E CAM control panel below the displays.
items.decision: E CAM is written so that the voice says ee-cam, as pilots do.

items.speech: A T C ground: Request taxi to the runway.
Takeoff and taxi lights: On.
Runway turnoff lights: On.

notes: Maximum 20 kt ground speed per career mode rules
items.speech: Taxi to the hold-short line, maximum 20 knots ground speed, per career mode rules.
items.decision: Taxi to...<destination> follows the existing wording and reads naturally; the preposition stays in the challenge. 20 kt ground speed is the MSFS 2024 career-mode taxi limit.

items.speech: Flight director: On.
Autopilot altitude: Set and use managed mode.

notes: Maximum 220 kt below 10,000 ft.
items.speech: Autopilot speed: Set 180 knots and use selected mode. Maximum 220 knots below 10,000 feet.
items.decision: The 220 kt maximum below 10,000 ft is a deliberate user choice for this in-game procedure instead of the common 250 kt limit.

items.speech: Probe lights: Bright.
Strobe lights: Bright.
A T C tower: Request departure.

notes: Line up on the runway.
Maximum 20 kt ground speed per career mode rules
items.speech: Taxi to the runway and line up, maximum 20 knots ground speed, per career mode rules.

sections.title: Takeoff
sections.decision: Takeoff and after-takeoff actions are combined for a fast flow without explanations: no approximate Vr, pitch limit, positive-climb or F1-marker condition. Flaps come before MCL because the flap-retraction speed is reached well before the PFD prompts MCL.

items.speech: Power levers: Toga.
items.decision: The power levers are coupled and always moved as one block, so the challenge has no component scope. TOGA is spoken as the word Toga, as pilots say it.

items.speech: At rotation speed V R: Rotate.
items.decision: Same challenge as the other checklists; without a fixed Vr, the response is the action.

items.speech: Pitch: Follow the flight director.
Autopilot: Engage.

items.condition: At thrust reduction altitude, when prompted on the PFD
items.speech: Power levers: M C L at thrust reduction altitude, when prompted on the P F D.
items.decision: The power levers are coupled and always moved as one block, so the challenge has no component scope.

items.speech: Ground spoilers: Disarm.
Takeoff and taxi lights: Off.
Runway turnoff lights: Off.
Landing lights: Off above 10,000 feet.
Altimeters one and two: Standard at transition altitude.
Flight plan arrival page, runway, approach and Star: Set as assigned by air traffic control.
items.decision: STAR is spoken as the word Star, as pilots say it.

items.challenge: [PERF] APPR MAG WIND, OAT and QNH
notes: Use the arrival METAR on the EFB Home page.
items.speech: Performance page, approach panel, magnetic wind, outside air temperature and Q N H: Set. Use the arrival M E T A R on the E F B home page.

items.challenge: [PERF] APPR MINIMUM BARO or RADIO, TRANS
notes: From the approach chart.
RADIO if the minimum is marked R, otherwise BARO.
items.speech: Performance page, approach panel, barometric or radio minimum and transition setting: Set from the approach chart. Select radio if the minimum is marked with the letter R; otherwise select barometric.
Verify position menu, navigation aids page, landing system identifier, frequency or channel and course: Match the approach chart.

notes: From the approach chart.
Do not activate the altitude change yet.
items.speech: Autopilot altitude: Set the glideslope intercept altitude from the approach chart. Do not activate the altitude change yet.

items.condition: At TOD or when instructed by ATC
notes: TOD symbol on the ND: level arrow bending down to the right.
Use speed brakes if above the descent path or glideslope.
items.speech: At top of descent or when instructed by air traffic control, autopilot altitude: Use managed mode. The top of descent symbol on the navigation display is a level arrow bending down to the right. Use speed brakes if above the descent path or glideslope.

notes: Shows localizer and glideslope on the PFD.
items.speech: Landing system: On. Shows the localizer and glideslope on the primary flight display.

items.condition: At transition level or when instructed by ATC
items.speech: At transition level or when instructed by air traffic control, altimeters one and two: Set Q N H.
Landing lights: On below 10,000 feet.
Takeoff and taxi lights: On.
Runway turnoff lights: On.

sections.title: Approach
sections.decision: The QRC v1.0.0 approach item Engine Start Selector: As Required is deliberately omitted.

items.condition: At the DECEL point (D on the ND) or when vectored for the approach
notes: Activates the approach speeds.
items.speech: Performance page, approach panel: Activate approach at the deceleration point, marked with the letter D on the navigation display, or when vectored for the approach. This activates the approach speeds.
Below 235 knots, flaps: Set to position one.

notes: Arms localizer and glideslope.
items.speech: When cleared for the approach, autopilot approach button: Press. This arms the localizer and glideslope.
Autopilot two: Engage for autoland.

notes: Extend step by step.
items.speech: Flaps: Extend step by step from position two to full as speed decreases.
items.decision: Landing flap extension is deliberately combined into one item; speed limits are read from the PFD.

items.speech: Ground spoilers: Arm.

notes: For example MED, depending on the runway length.
items.speech: Auto brakes: As required. For example, medium, depending on the runway length.

notes: Exact value: VAPP on the PERF APPR page.
items.speech: Approach speed, V app, on final approach with flaps full: Approximately 140 knots. Use the exact approach speed on the performance page, approach panel.
